scripts.sigil:compile: cd .. && sigil compile src/gameApi.lib.sigil && rm -rf web/src/generated && mkdir -p web/src/generated/core web/src/generated/src web/src/generated/stdlib && cp -f .local/core/*.mjs web/src/generated/core/ && cp -f .local/src/*.mjs web/src/generated/src/ && cp -f .local/stdlib/*.mjs web/src/generated/stdlib/ && printf 'export function bootstrap(): Promise<unknown>;\n' > web/src/generated/src/gameApi.d.mts
scripts.build: npm run sigil:compile && tsc && vite build
